# Calibration

## Protocol Position

- Calibrate before implementation planning.

## Required Activities

- Route, calibrate, frame, contract, execute, reconcile, and codify.

## Human Gates

- Ask for approval when project contract choices are unresolved.

## Drift Controls

- Stop when owner, seam, direction, or shape assumptions break.

## Codification Rules

- Codify durable discoveries as local rule supplements.

## Review Checks

- Contract choices are explicit.

## Handoff Checks

- Approved choices can feed planning.
